description: t.p spawns a child that sleeps, acknowledges a cancel at its checkpoint (on_cancel continue) and then returns an error value, aborts it at 50 and joins it. A spawned child that acknowledged an attributed cancel after its first poll keeps its returned value (SpawnCompletionPolicy::PreserveAcknowledgedCancellationResult, cx.rs:4901): the join observes the child's own err return, not Cancelled.
